messages:
Morgan: Quick async on Embeddings & Rerank export UI. Focus: batch inputs, vector preview, relevance table, and export flow. Figma: https://figma.com/file/emb-rerank-v5 :eyes:

Anya: Batch uploader looks good. Request: show 3-row sample parse preview and a 'skip malformed rows' toggle. Show processed/total in the header.

Sana: A11y: ensure mapping dropdowns have labels and that the sample preview is readable by screen readers. Add aria-live for upload progress and announce 'upload complete' when done. Color contrast: darken score bar to #0B6F4A.

Priya: Copy: change "Include vectors" toggle label to "Include raw vectors (NDJSON, gz recommended for large jobs)" and the export button to "Export summary" / "Export raw vectors". Add a tiny size estimate next to the selector.

Ravi: Backend: limit CSV uploads to 10k rows (413 if exceeded). For raw exports >1k we'll stream gzipped NDJSON and expose X-Export-Size-Estimate header. Recommend defaulting to summary for large jobs.

DevBot: Note: export streaming endpoint added in API v2. See PR #4521.

Morgan: Plan: two-mode export (summary vs raw). Default summary; raw requires confirm if >1k with size warning. Action items: @Anya add sample preview, @Sana finalize a11y checklist, @Priya finalize copy, @Ravi document export limits. Drop screenshots in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
